_approach: Offbeat double-kick gallop under the hoover-bass pump: a soft kick on the 16th just before each beat (the same trick hard techno inherited from 90s hard trance), thinning to just beats 2 and 4 in bar 2 so the hoover stab reads clearly. A muted cowbell ghosts the hoover hits in bar 2. Reference: Mauro Picotto 'Komodo', Cosmic Gate 'Fire Wire'. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
